title: Durable native DTMF recipient attempts and current named signal authority
scope: Isolated local macOS arm64 Store/protocol verification. New recipient cases use controlled native readiness/observations and no physical DTMF IO. This report does not establish service delivery or the exact auxiliary vectors.
implementation: Schema84 sealed source observation, immutable original native target/registration snapshots and once-per-actual-output-frame reservation. No reconstruction of an existing batch.

prepare_native_dtmf_with_peer derives original current grant; try_native_dtmf_read freshly acquires complete joint current source/target authority and named dtmf.send/dtmf.receive independently of media. Queues hold metadata only.

try_start_native_dtmf_write binds one actual frame before IO; try_record_native_dtmf_outcome appends one immutable local fact even after revocation/retirement. Another frame cannot reuse this recipient attempt.

finish_native_dtmf requires all local jobs stopped/facts recorded: completed only if every target submitted, failed for known partial/no effect, cancelled if cancelled without effects, unknown for any uncertainty. Unknown stopped work closes its control slot without retry.
recover_native_dtmf marks reserved frames unknown and never-attempted recipients not_started, preserves original effects and does not schedule IO. CanonicalRuntime startup invokes recovery.
Shared journal budget reserves each pending recipient outcome. Exact-capacity and immediate storage contention tests pass. Current Event/journal kinds remain operation_updated.

Current operations HTTP/OpenAPI now describes problem and NativeDtmfSubmission; docs/developer/native-dtmf-journal.md updated. These documentation changes happened after compiled-input snapshot; final source proof must distinguish them.

store.scope: Complete current Store library; three top-level subprocess fixture helpers are explicitly ignored and invoked by parent tests.

new_recipient_cases.scope: Frozen observations/targets, named source/receiver grants, exact frame reservation, immutable local results, revocation/retirement, cancellation/partial/unknown, SQL rollback/retry, startup recovery, shared capacity, key/device/Endpoint/membership changes, held readers and immediate SQL contention.

connect_server.result: passed locked offline single-job compile check

openapi.scope: OpenAPI definition/vector shape only; these vectors are synthetic, not physical IO or actual HTTP responses.

source_verification.scope: Only developer documentation changed. Operations OpenAPI was added to this phase after the compiled snapshot; its SHA is separately recorded.

http_reference.scope: Optional OperationRecord.problem and local NativeDtmfSubmission summary; synthetic schema shapes, no actual HTTP response claim.

Attempted non-completed result_json violated established DB contract. Corrected by keeping per-recipient facts journaled in separate table; only success uses result, final failure/unknown/cancelled details use problem.signal.
